overview_description.description: Standard Signal develops and operates an AI hedge fund built on financial large language models that autonomously research and execute trades within predefined risk parameters. The company trains reasoning models that analyze order flow, market microstructure, and global macroeconomic and geopolitical data in real time. These models generate trading signals across asset classes and implement market-neutral strategies while maintaining strict constraints on position sizing and drawdown. Standard Signal emphasizes explainable decision-making, creating an audit trail from signal generation to order execution. It offers capital deployment opportunities for qualified investors as limited partners who gain exposure to its AI-driven trading systems.
